payload.text: ExoticInputs::carry_df() is a pure accessor computing the yield/foreign discount factor e^{-q*t} as exp(-self.carry.yield_rate() * self.t) — no side effects. Crucially it reads the yield rate q through Carry::yield_rate(), which for Carry::FxRates returns the STORED r_for verbatim; it must NEVER reconstruct q as discount_rate() - carry_rate() (r_dom - (r_dom - r_for) does not round-trip bit-for-bit). This keeps the foreign-leg discount e^{-r_for*t} byte-identical to the FX two-rate form on the exotics carry seam (ADR-0008 FX bit-identity).
